posts.title: Love and attachment
posts.description: They are totally different. Attachment is clinging tightly, possessive, jealous, does not give spaces to someone, constrict them. It's seeking happiness through someone else's. Love , on the other hand, is kindness , compassion , and Bodhicitta 1 . It's seeking happiness in the happiness of another. Kindness is the antidote of anger. Kindness it not the same as just being nice to someone. Kindness
